data.notes: Predecessor of GLA H247 is the X156 (2014-2020 in Germany), split into pre-facelift (2014-2017) and facelift (2017-2020). No plug-in hybrid or BEV existed. Trunk 421/1235 l VDA for all variants incl. 4MATIC and AMG per ADAC. Pre-facelift GLA 45 AMG height 1416 mm per ADAC is questionable (other sources 1479 mm). 11 of 20 searches used.

missing.detail: X156 (Vor-Facelift): early GLA 45 AMG 4MATIC with 265 kW / 360 PS (incl. Edition 1), sold 2014 to 2015 before the 381 PS update, is not a separate variant (the 381 PS variant starts 2015). Sources: autoklicker.de (GLA 45 AMG, 265 kW/360 PS, AMG SPEEDSHIFT DCT, seit Juli 2014), automobile-catalog.com (2014 GLA 45 AMG 4MATIC Edition 1, 265 kW/360 PS). Trunk 421/1235 l is the same as the series.

verification.notes: Third-party sources (encycarpedia, AutoScout24, autobild) confirm the base X156 at 4417 x 1804 x 1494 mm, wheelbase 2699 mm, trunk 421-1235 l. Facelift length 4424 mm matches AutoScout24 and fastcarcheck. Production years: TopGear.nl gives 2013-2020; angurten gives 2013-2019. The data's 2014-2020 window for Germany is plausible. The unconfirmed value is the pre-facelift GLA 45 AMG height of 1416 mm (ADAC). Carfolio gives 1479 mm, speed-magazin 1.48 m, carsguide/autoevolution 1494 mm. No source gives 1416 mm, so it is likely an ADAC error. 1479 mm is the most likely value, but no manufacturer source was found, so it is not reported as a correction. The pre-facelift GLA 45 length of 4445 mm matches Carfolio. Facelift GLA 45 length/height (null) are still conflicting: 4445/1494 (paultan), 4424/1480 (fastcarcheck, caroom), 4455/1479 (auto-data). Leaving them null is justified. No official Daimler press kit was retrieved. 7 searches used.
